notes.title: VER. 1.13 - Achievements, new endings and maps.
notes.content:
Dead Dreams has been updated to ver. 1.13!

- NG+ was removed. Now the [b]additional chapter[/b] and all [b]three endings[/b] are available from the [b]first playthrough[/b]!
- [b]14[/b] new [b]achievements [/b]added!
- Improved visuals and cutscenes (weather effects, filters).

notes.title: VER 1.1 is here!
notes.content:
Version 1.1 is here!
[list]
[*] Crucial reveals about the IRIS' project's goal were moved from CH4 to CH2
[*] Certain lore details\explanations have been changed\simplified.
[*] New intro and CH3's dialogue that's crucial for better understanding of the correct timeline and the main plot.
[*] A brand new ending with better transition, including three new cutscenes and two maps.
[*] Gems backstory simplified and partially moved to NG+
[*] Minor changes (difficulty, items placement, etc)
[/list]
